# Job Application Tracker

> An open-source (Apache-2.0), self-hosted, local-first web app for tracking a job search,
> built for software engineers. No account, no cloud, no AI and no tracking or telemetry: it
> runs on localhost (Linux or macOS), never scrapes job boards or contacts anyone, and keeps
> all data in one local directory outside the code (SQLite plus a plain-text JSON Lines and
> Markdown export), with optional automatic git snapshots as backups.

Status: version 1.0, ready and in daily use; versions follow semantic versioning, with a
GitHub release for each (see CHANGELOG.md). Windows support, a one-command install and Docker are planned.

What it does:
- Today, the home page (`/`; `/next-actions` redirects there): Your move (replies to read,
  offers to answer, how did it go?, to-dos due, follow-ups, roles to decide), Coming up
  (interviews, calls, dated to-dos, unbooked rounds) and Waiting on them (waiting to hear
  back, gone quiet), under counts and the pipeline; a numbered "How it works".
- Applications list and Kanban board (move between any stages; optionally a column per
  interview round), application pages with an "At a glance" card (what needs attention, for
  how long, key dates as "3 weeks ago"), duplicate-submission warnings, renaming, deleting.
- Recruiter CRM: agencies and people (one person per email address and LinkedIn profile;
  merge two records, `POST /api/v1/contacts/{id}/merge`), person pages with booked and logged
  calls and meetings (`/api/v1/meetings`), favourites (`favourite` on contacts), and
  chased / ghosted / not interested, with a ghost before a ghosted person's name everywhere.
- Roles to decide before applying (`/api/v1/role-summaries`): pitched by whom, on which
  call; apply, mark interested (role status `interested`, or `closed` with `closed_as`) or
  pass; a page per role whose files (e.g. the job description) show on the application.
- What Today lists (`GET /api/v1/next-actions`): to-dos (`/api/v1/todos`), follow-ups due, applications gone
  quiet, waiting to hear back, replies to read, interviews coming up, one-click follow-up,
  snooze and Ghosted, and "usually replies within N working days" per person (`replies`,
  `usual_reply_days` on contacts).
- Interview rounds in the user's own words ("Round 2 · System design test"), rescheduled from
  the application page, the quick view (the current round, in an active stage), Today or the
  Interviews page and marked so, with each move's old and new time, who needed the change and
  why on the application's timeline, the Timeline page and Today's Recent activity.
- Markdown notes as real files, links, attachments and `.eml` import onto the timeline;
  versioned CVs and cover letters.
- Timeline across every role, application, company, agency and person, by day or as lanes
  (`GET /api/v1/timeline`; `/timeline?about=contact:<id>&period=all`, or `company:`, `agency:`).
- Insights: the whole picture, one Sankey diagram from each role's source (through a
  recruiter, referred, found yourself) to passed, deciding, its stages and what's still
  waiting (`GET /api/v1/insights/whole-flow`); stage flows by date and route; conversion and
  median time per stage; direct vs recruiter outcomes; weekly activity; a recruiter and
  agency scorecard; recruiter conversations (`GET /api/v1/insights/conversations`).
- An A/B test of CV and cover-letter versions (heard back, screens or interviews, offers, a
  95% range, Fisher's exact test; `GET /api/v1/insights/documents`); identical CV files on
  applications, roles or people become versions (`GET /api/v1/cv-files`,
  `POST /api/v1/cv-files/adopt`).
- Offers side by side (salary, bonus, equity, pension and holiday, or day rate, IR35 and
  length, with a worth-a-year figure and reply deadlines on Today).
- Backups: git-backed snapshots, a one-click zip (`GET /api/v1/backup/archive` or
  `jat archive`), restore (`jat restore`).
- Full-text search across everything, notes included (`GET /api/v1/search?q=`, or press /).

Stack: Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Alembic and SQLite (with a JSON Lines export
committed to the user's private data repo); React 19, TypeScript, Mantine, TanStack
Router/Query and d3-sankey. Run with `uv run jat --data-dir <dir> serve`
(http://127.0.0.1:8770); try demo data with `uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py /tmp/jat-demo`.
The JSON API is documented at http://127.0.0.1:8770/api/docs; insights live under
`/api/v1/insights/` (`whole-flow`, `flow`, `stats`, `activity`, `scorecard`, `rescheduling`,
`conversations`, `documents`).
